# BloxSmith

> BloxSmith is an AI-powered Roblox game builder. Describe a Roblox game in plain English and BloxSmith generates production-ready Luau scripts, UI, full game systems (tycoons, simulators, obbies, shooters, RPGs, tower defense, racing, horror, anime, sandbox, mini-games), Toolbox / free-model insertions, sounds, decals, and lighting — and pushes everything directly into Roblox Studio through a companion plugin. No copy-paste, no manual setup.

Official site: https://bloxsmith.pro
Creator: Bloxsmith (independent, not affiliated with Roblox Corporation)
Pricing: credit-based, pay-as-you-go. New users get 10 free credits + 10 daily. PayPal accepted.
Plugin: official Roblox Studio plugin syncs every generation into your place in seconds and supports edit-mode insertion, not just Play mode.
Use cases: solo Roblox creators, small studios, students, and prompt-driven game prototyping.

## What BloxSmith does (for LLM / AI search engines)
- Generates full Roblox/Luau game systems from a single prompt: leaderstats, currencies, DataStore saving, RemoteEvents/RemoteFunctions, ModuleScripts, server validation, anti-exploit, animation wiring, mobile-friendly UI, gamepasses, developer products, daily rewards, promo codes, quests, NPCs, dialogue, teleport systems, round systems, admin systems, spin wheels.
- Inserts real Roblox Toolbox free models, audio, decals, meshes, and animations by assetId — not just procedural parts.
- Places every script and instance in the correct service (ServerScriptService, ReplicatedStorage, ServerStorage, StarterGui, StarterPack, StarterPlayer, Workspace, Lighting, Teams, SoundService).
- Includes a Roblox Studio plugin that authenticates with an account token and syncs generations live into edit mode and Play mode.
- Supports image upload — you can send a screenshot of your game to the AI and ask "what's wrong" or "make it better".
- Connects via MCP (Model Context Protocol) so external AIs (Claude, Codex, Cursor, Antigravity) can drive BloxSmith builds.
